items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: all of us was in those days mainly my parents plus Michael

ctx.x: And I think you were four years old when Dave suffered that accident that made his back an issue. Do you remember those early days and sometimes kids aren’t aware that — how are they going to pay the rent. You know we’re not involved in paying the rent when we’re kids, but I guess my question is do you remember that the family was struggling for a while and that Dave and Iola both were trying to figure out how to make a living in music?

Of course I know all about that retrospectively. I’m trying — look I think they were pretty good at making us feel secure no matter what and for a young child, whatever your parents accept as normal is normal. They define that. I was on the beach when that happened — the diving — well “diving accident” I don’t mean scuba, I mean he went to dive into a wave and it was just too shallow and he hit his head and he had to be pulled out of the water and he had literally broken his neck and he was taken off the beach…
And you got your name on the guest list.
